name: Cloth Request
summary: At the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, Rema Schneider receives Harlan Bagley's request for fresh cloth and knitted goods. His shelves are emptying quickly.

sections.title: A Run on Sturdy Goods
sections.body: Harlan Bagley asks Rema Schneider for a fresh supply of knitted garments and cloth. Bagley notes a sudden and unsettling surge in trade: citizens and travelers are buying armor and sturdy clothing as if bracing for a brutal season. The rush leaves Rema puzzled and wary. The House of Nobles has announced no open war, so Rema wonders why city folk are quietly armoring themselves and whether the crown's leaders are hiding unrest.

faq.answer: The Cloth Request is Harlan Bagley's written order to Rema Schneider for fresh cloth and knitted wear to restock his store.

faq.q: Why does Harlan Bagley need more cloth?
aliases: why is bagley out of stock
faq.answer: Bagley's business has been unusually busy. Townsfolk and travelers have bought armor and sturdy clothing in large quantities, exhausting his stock.

faq.q: Where does this request need to go?
aliases: where do i take the cloth request
faq.answer: The order goes to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, along Stormwind's waterways.

faq.q: Why are people in Stormwind buying so much armor and clothing?
faq.answer: Neither merchants nor commoners know for certain. Rema Schneider finds the sudden rush unnerving and wonders whether the noble court is concealing brewing hostilities or danger from the public.

angles.text: The request points to Stormwind's textile trade, where neighborhood clothiers like the Schneiders supply general stores and outfitters with woven goods.
Stormwind's citizens feel uneasy and prepare for strife, despite the regency making no official announcements.
